description: Review of environmental factors for proposed reconstruction and widening of Cowpasture Road between North Liverpool Road, Green Valley and Elizabeth Drive, Bonnyrigg Heights + Decision report is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The proposal addressed in this document is to reconstruct the 2.2 kilometre section of Cowpasture Road from 200 metres south of North Liverpool Road, Green Valley to 300 metres north of Elizabeth Drive, Bonnyrigg Heights from an existing two lane undivided road to a four lane dual carriageway road.
